Name: Layla's Shirt Mod
Author: Layla
TagLine: Content Patcher shirt mod that adds 95 various shirts to the game.
Description:
A mod that adds 95 shirts to the game (a full list below)
Requires Content Patcher﻿!

Simply extract the contents of the zip in the 'Mods' folder.
If the file doesn't open with windows explorer, try using a dedicated program (like 7-zip) to open it instead.

NOTE: the added shirts are an 'incomplete' line, so last slot of the shirt selection in character creation *will* be empty

This is my first time making a mod and pretty much the first time I've made pixel art so any and all commentary, feedback or critisizm (as long as you keep it cool) is welcome. Also the sleeves may look a bit off when you're cycling through them, but mostly look like they're supposed to.


I do requests (sort of). If you'd like to see a new shirt or want me to merge it with another mod (If you've asked that author for permission too) then you can more easily contact me on my tumblr @laylaisthename, or leave a comment here or on nexus mods (same mod name, by lhijazi)
